title: ModelCheckOutcome
description: One turn with a fixed minimal prompt, no tools, one turn, a spending ceiling — the only thing this plan does that spends quota, and only on a click (plan 13, B-12, D-08). Shared by an engine's own diagnostics route and by its installation view's `lastModelCheck` (plan 28, B-48).

result.description: What the test of the connection found — data of the answer, never an error.

model.description: The model that answered, when one did.

costUsd.description: What the turn cost in US dollars, as a decimal string — the money convention this contract already uses for `turn.completed`'s `costUsd` (a float would round where nobody looked). `null` when the CLI said nothing.

reason.description: Why it did not pass, as a stable word the screen translates (`authentication`, `billing`…).
